observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' and 'D3300' printed on the front.
A kit lens is shown next to the body, barrel printed 'Nikon AF-S DX VR 18-55mm' with focal markings 24-55.
Both camera and lens are posed on top of a retail box printed 'Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit, AF-S DX Nikkor 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II, Black'.
Background shows unrelated flash units (Godox TT520, Yongnuo) and other boxed electronics, suggesting a shop/stall setting, not the seller's personal item alone.
No photo of the rear LCD screen, memory card slot, battery compartment, lens mount contacts, or lens glass close-up.
No photo of a shutter count reading or software screen.
Both photos are near-identical angles of the same static setup; no image shows the camera powered on or a sample photo taken with it.

identity.model: D3300 with AF-S DX Nikkor 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II

claims.evidence: This is a known factory spec for the D3300 model name seen in photo 0/1, but cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
No video or burst-mode evidence shown; matches stated model's factory spec only.
No menu screen or focus test shown.
No screenshot of shutter-count software or EXIF data provided in either photo.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens cap is on in photo 1 and no macro shot of the front/rear glass elements is given in either photo.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Battery, charger, and any internal service stickers are not shown in photo 0 or 1.

risks.risk: Actual shutter count may be far higher than claimed, affecting sensor/shutter life.
risks.proof: Screenshot from a shutter-count checker (e.g., Nikon MyAssistant or online EXIF tool) using a fresh photo from the camera.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, haze, or scratches not visible with the cap on.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements with a light shone through, cap off.

risks.risk: Sensor or autofocus may not function correctly despite cosmetic condition.
risks.proof: A sample photo taken with the camera and lens, plus a video of autofocus hunting/acquiring focus.

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not be original or may hold little charge.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger with visible Nikon branding/model numbers, plus battery percentage/health if shown on camera menu.

risks.risk: Rear LCD screen condition unknown (common wear point).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear screen powered on, showing no cracks or dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a flawed or unverified screen

risks.risk: Listing photos appear to be stock/shop display images rather than the actual unit for sale (other branded boxes in background suggest a multi-item shop).
risks.proof: A fresh photo of this specific unit with a handwritten date/seller name note beside it, or a live video walkaround.
risks.if_unproven: priced with added uncertainty on unit-specific condition

proof_requests: Screenshot of shutter count from Nikon software or an EXIF-reading site using a photo just taken with this camera.
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens glass with the cap removed.
Photo of the rear LCD screen powered on.
Photo of the battery and charger showing Nikon branding/model numbers.
A sample photo or short video demonstrating autofocus and shutter operation.
response.reason: The body and lens model are clearly identifiable from the photos, so pricing is possible, but all condition and usage claims (shutter count, lens cleanliness, originality of battery/charger, working status) are unverified and must be priced at worst case until supporting shots are provided.
